_help: Act 2, the caravanserai: hiring Youssef Nabil, the young scout (hired_youssef), 25. Promising him the credit (promised_youssef_credit) feeds his ambition (conviction). Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act2.py.

already.speaker: youssef
already.line: When do we go? Today? Tomorrow is fine also.

first.speaker: youssef
first.line: You are going to Akmentar? Take me! I find roads where there are no roads. I am fast, I am cheap, and I am not afraid.

choices.label: Ask how far he's been
choices.line: Have you ever been that far west?

honest.speaker: youssef
honest.line: Not that far. Not yet. But somebody has to be the first, no?

fee.speaker: youssef
fee.line: Twenty-five pounds. And when we find it, you tell them I am the one who found the road.

choices.label: Pay and promise
choices.line: Twenty-five, and the road is yours.

choices.label: Pay, no promises
choices.line: Twenty-five. Credit goes to whoever earns it.

joined.speaker: youssef
joined.line: You will not be sorry! I go and tell my uncle.
